description: This file is a Python script that serves as an entry point to start a FastAPI application using uvicorn. It sets environment variables, computes the application directory path, adjusts the Python path, attempts to import configuration settings for host and port, and finally runs uvicorn with the specified parameters.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Function that initializes environment variables, computes app paths, imports configuration, and starts the uvicorn server.
